hook_text: Ice, water and steam look totally different. But they are made of exactly the same thing.
clip_script: A school field in Pietermaritzburg. Be a solid: shoulder to shoulder, in rows, just jiggling. Warm up, and melt: now you can slide past each other. That's a liquid! Heat up more and boil: run apart in every direction. That's a gas! Same learners, same particles. Only the spacing and the speed changed.
visual_style: Whiteboard dots packed in rows, then loosely sliding, then scattered with speed lines, beside ice, water and a steaming kettle.
mood: Energetic and playful, like a game on the sports field.
pacing: Three quick changes of state, then the big reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and act out a solid, a liquid and a gas with friends.
